posts.text: Ghostty is getting an updated AI policy. AI assisted PRs are now only allowed for accepted issues. Drive-by AI PRs will be closed without question. Bad AI drivers will be banned from all future contributions. If you're going to use AI, you better be good.
posts.notes: Ghostty AI contribution policy update. Quality gate: AI PRs only for accepted issues, drive-bys closed. 174K views. Signals quality-over-volume approach to AI-assisted OSS contributions.
